description: Use when you need speech to text transcription or translation of an audio file at a public URL. Do not use for audio over 10 MB or speaker labels. Returns JSON with a Whisper transcription of an audio file: text, timed segments and language, or an English translation for 0.005 USDC per megabyte, up to 0.05 USDC per call (clients without upto pay the cap). Result in the same call (about 20000 ms); a status tool polls for free if it takes longer. Category: Media.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the spoken language, e.g. en or pt (detected when omitted)

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON

task.description: transcribe keeps the spoken language; translate returns English (transcribe when omitted)

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the audio file, e.g. https://example.com/talk.mp3 (mp3, wav, ogg, m4a, webm; up to 10 MB)

name: blackwood_audio_transcribe

next.description: Suggested next paid call in the same family (call it in a loop when the task continues)

sample.description: Free fixed sample of the whole family

service.description: Service id of the suggested next paid call

tool.description: MCP tool name of the same call

url.description: Paid route of the next call

useWhen.description: When the next call is the right one

anyOf.description: x402 PaymentRequired (returned with isError when payment is needed)

title: Speech to text
